# GERmanikure i08 Nail Cleaner: Handmade German Steel for Clean, Healthy Nails

Keep your manicure routine precise with the i08 Nail Cleaner, a leather-sheathed tool forged from Finox surgical stainless steel and hand sharpened by artisans in Solingen, Germany.

## Built to Last

Crafted from high carbon stainless steel, this nail cleaner resists rust and holds a fine edge through repeated use. The protective leather case keeps the blade covered between sessions, so the tool stays ready for your next manicure.

## Clean Nails, Every Time

Use the slim, maneuverable tip to lift dirt from beneath your nails and work carefully around the cuticle area. Reviewers note it handles everyday grime and even ingrown nail areas with comfort and control, making it a dependable part of a quality manicure or pedicure.

## Made Responsibly

Every GERmanikure tool is handcrafted in socially and environmentally responsible facilities, and the brand refuses to participate in child labor. Each product carries a lifetime guarantee, so you can invest in a tool you'll keep for years.

## Add It to Your Kit

Ready to upgrade your grooming routine? Add the i08 Nail Cleaner to your cart today and experience German precision in every stroke.
